excerpt: Quanta Computer Inc (廣達), which supplies artificial intelligence (AI) servers powered by Nvidia Corp chips, yesterday said that AI servers are on track to account for 70 percent of its total server revenue this year
notes: 70% is share of Quanta's server revenue, not total revenue, so no weight recorded.
